title: The hype is real!!! #Broadway #BroadwayPlay  #LiberationPlay #Theatre...
transcript: Everything that you have heard about the show is true. Liberation is a play that just opened on Broadway to unanimously positive reviews. I feel like everyone and their mother is talking about how good this play is, and let me tell you, they are right. As the title implies, this is a show exploring the concept of women's liberation and what that actually means, because freedom and liberation mean different things to different people. The show takes place in the 70s and follows a group of women who meet on a weekly basis to discuss this very topic and to talk about ways that they can liberate their own lives as well as fight for liberation for women around the world. This play eliminates not only the progress that was made thanks to the conversation that these women and women like them were having, but also the lack of progress and the way that many of these same conversations are still continuing today. And that's largely what makes the show feel so urgent. And on top of that, some truly phenomenal performances across the board, and you have yourself a can't miss play of the season. I do want to specifically shout out Susanna Flood and Betsy Aidem, both of whom I think are giving fantastic and nuanced performances, and I very much expect to be in the conversation come Tony's. In fact, I very much think that this show is going to be in conversation for a lot Of Tony Awards and so if you have time to check it out, I definitely recommend it.
reasoning: Broadway Ben calls it a 'can't miss play of the season,' praises phenomenal performances, predicts Tony recognition, and explicitly recommends it.
